newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade very slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade very slow - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said.

Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 200 slaughter heifers; 57,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 10,800 formulated and 300 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 67.00.
Wk to Date - 58,100 Week Ago - 50,900 Year Ago - 80,800
